notes: Clean lane: no quantifiable exploit in the server chunk beyond known-ledger entries (security-MAJ-12-r1 DNS rebinding through sameOriginGuard covers every new mutating route: /profile, /profile/style, /welcome/bootstrap, /sessions/archive/*). Cross-chunk for the station: (1) handleWelcomeBootstrap passes BOOTSTRAP_EXTRA_PROMPT to cmd/bootstrap/run.sh and bootstrapEnv rejects only quotes and newlines — $( ), backticks and ; pass, so safety depends on run.sh never eval-ing or unquoted-expanding it into a shell string; not verifiable in this chunk. (2) The bootstrap log at os.TempDir()/smine-bootstrap.log, 0644, opened without O_NOFOLLOW, is per-user on macOS/Windows but shared /tmp on Linux; the fix carried by known correctness-BLK-5-r1 (move it under the routine logs dir) also closes this. Scope: nothing removed from the 48 manifest files.
